intro: The Trial of the Lake is a timed challenge held in Moonglade that tests an initiate's physical dexterity and speed. Aspirants must dive into Lake Elune'ara to retrieve an unstable Shrine Bauble and rush it to the Shrine of Remulos before it decays. Successful completion earns recognition from the warden Tajarri and honors the Cenarion Circle's dedication to balance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For your first trial, search the depths of Lake Elune'ara to locate a Shrine Bauble. It decays rapidly, so proceed with it to the Shrine of Remulos post haste. Use the bauble at the shrine, and then speak with Tajarri there; she is one of Moonglade's most trusted wardens.

You only have a set amount of time to complete the task, and you may be competing against other adventurers searching for baubles themselves. Mental and physical dexterity will be critical to your success.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well now, it looks like yet another adventurer has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake! Well done, my young friend - well done.

As I've said, my name is Tajarri. It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for Moonglade, and specifically this shrine. Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance, and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. By using the bauble here, it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.
